summary.text: Seth Funk is the Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 1C, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he works as a Resident Advisor at the Victor Cullen Center in Sabillasville and lives in Williamsport.

paragraphs.text: Seth Funk earned a high school diploma from Williamsport High School, an associate degree from Hagerstown Community College in 2020 and a bachelor's degree from St. Mary's College of Maryland in 2024, according to Ballotpedia.
In the survey, he said he grew up outside Fairplay and studied political science and policy.

Funk said he has organized in Washington County with groups working on substance abuse and homelessness, and that he joined an effort to put data center zoning on the ballot in Frederick County, which he said collected more than 22,000 signatures in under three months.
He said he is running to bring investment to Western Maryland and for development that addresses a community need.
